correctness.rationale: Unordered 2-particle cubical chain complex has C2=Z^72 and C1=Z^96. A rank-60 reduction modulo 3 plus 12 independent torus cycles proves rational boundary rank exactly 60. The 12-by-12 torus coordinate minor is −1, proving primitive and hence full integral kernel generation. The six signed relations are checked in C2 and eliminate six torus columns with unit coefficients, establishing a complete integer presentation; all are reproducibly verified by verify.py.

value.rationale: The complete integral presentation of all geometrically minimal disjoint-square product tori tests the natural nonplanar case where two disjoint cycles can first fit in a complete bipartite graph. A rational spanning representation leaves possible finite lattice index, now eliminated by an explicit unimodular minor. Twelve concrete tori and six complete relations enable further cycle-level configuration computations. The object is canonical and the exact integral question is motivated independently of numerical experimentation.
